response.sql: WITH country_counts AS (SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM player_college AS pc JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id GROUP BY p.birth_country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(record_count * 1.0) AS avg_count, SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM country_counts) SELECT SUM(c.record_count) AS total_record_count, AVG(c.record_count * 1.0 / o.total_count) AS average_share, AVG(c.record_count - o.avg_count) AS average_excess FROM country_counts AS c CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE c.record_count > o.avg_count

assumptions.assumption: Records with a NULL birth_country form one group, as they do under GROUP BY.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude records whose player's birth_country is NULL, since NULL does not identify a country.
alternatives.sql: WITH country_counts AS (SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM player_college AS pc JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id WHERE p.birth_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.birth_country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(record_count * 1.0) AS avg_count, SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM country_counts) SELECT SUM(c.record_count) AS total_record_count, AVG(c.record_count * 1.0 / o.total_count) AS average_share, AVG(c.record_count - o.avg_count) AS average_excess FROM country_counts AS c CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE c.record_count > o.avg_count
